_metadata.description: Cloudflare ingress & mode management: programmatic remote ingress via Cloudflare API v4, local config.yml fallback generation, and remote<->local mode switching/migration.

requirements.title: Add a scenario's public hostname via the Cloudflare API
requirements.description: In remote mode, adding a route pushes an ingress rule mapping <subdomain>.<domain> -> localhost:<fixed UI port> through the Cloudflare API v4 with no manual dashboard step.

requirements.title: Remove a scenario's public hostname via the Cloudflare API
requirements.description: Removing a route removes the corresponding Cloudflare ingress rule so the hostname is no longer publicly routed.

requirements.title: Sync Cloudflare ingress to match the manifest with hot-reload
requirements.description: A Sync operation reconciles live Cloudflare ingress against the route manifest (adding missing, removing stale rules) and applies changes via hot-reload without restarting the tunnel.

requirements.title: Generate ~/.cloudflared/config.yml from the manifest in local mode
requirements.description: In local mode the manifest is rendered to a valid ~/.cloudflared/config.yml ingress block as a fallback to the remote API, regenerated whenever the manifest changes.

requirements.title: Switch between remote and local modes with migration
requirements.description: SwitchMode migrates configuration between remote (Cloudflare API) and local (config.yml) modes so the active ingress source reflects the same manifest after switching.
